produces: Near-infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
combos.prerequisites: All three on the battlefield. Opponents' libraries have nonland cards.
combos.steps:
One or more nonland cards are milled: Mothman puts a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage draws a card.
Psychic Corrosion makes each opponent mill two cards.
Repeat while the milled cards include a nonland card.
combos.notes: Combo B in the deck's CLAUDE.md. Stops when a mill hits only lands; each draw is optional (Fathom Mage says 'may').
You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.
combos.prerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.
produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control
combos.steps:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

combos.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.
